findings.title: optional_path_posted_uncheck_roundtrips_test uses a REQUIRED cohort (student), contradicting its name and comment
findings.detail: Named/described as an OPTIONAL uncheck round-trip but fixtures student — a REQUIRED cohort under guarantor_required. The pin itself is live (old has_guarantor_default_check would re-mark students; verified: student+data re-render stays unchecked) and the true optional-uncheck case is pinned by retired_values_render_optional_with_hint_cohort_test (line 71). Misleading name/comment only.
findings.recommended_fix: Rename to reflect the required-cohort no-self-mark pin with data present (e.g. required_cohort_rerender_with_data_never_self_marks) and fix the comment.

findings.title: unemployed_values_render_required_test omits fields_open and no-pretick asserts the parallel student test has
findings.detail: Sibling student test (line 57) additionally pins _guarantor_fields_open="on" and the checkbox not pre-ticked; the unemployed twin asserts only cohort + required. A regression breaking unemployed fields-open or pre-tick would pass undetected.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror the student test's two extra assertions in the unemployed test for parallel coverage.

findings.title: Declared-required notices, retired-hint, and checkbox-gate render contract has no automated test — still present since round 1
findings.evidence: grep 'guarantor-required-notice|guarantor-retired-hint|_guarantor_required' server/test scripts → zero matches; bug-hunt not in .github/workflows (verified: only cpi-freshness, deploy-*, pr-checks, rental-tax-freshness, test.yml). guarantor_section_test pins only the _guarantor_* synthetics + checkbox state.
findings.detail: The data-condition wiring for the per-cohort notices, retired hint, and checkbox-gate hide (the core of the declared-required render) is asserted only by bug-hunt E2E scenarios, which are manual-only — not CI. Carried from r1 note N4; the delta did not touch this area.
findings.recommended_fix: Add string.contains assertions for the notice data-testids + the checkbox-gate data-condition in guarantor_section_test.gleam (ahead-notes already pinned in form_view_test.gleam — same pattern).

findings.title: Advisory test gate: PASS
findings.detail: P0 100% (required-cohort persistence null-out + attestation pinned end-to-end; validation force by cohort matrix; both silent ticks killed and pinned). P1 ~92%, overall ~94%. Lone P2 gap: notice/gate render contract E2E-only. Independently re-confirmed: 380/380 integration pass at the reviewed sha (perkins ran the suite).

carry_forward_notes.title: Cohort flip after filling silently unchecks the box and wipes filled guarantor fields — still present since round 1
carry_forward_notes.detail: Engine unchanged in the r1→r2 delta. Switching a required cohort (student→employed) closes the fields div → clearInputsWithin wipes the six filled guarantor values. Old code kept tick+data across cohort changes; the checkbox now reflects the applicant's last action (user-ruled), but the data wipe is a state-loss side effect. Recommend: skip clearInputsWithin when the cohort (not the box) drives the close, or accept and document.

carry_forward_notes.title: Requirement row fires for filled-but-malformed guarantor fields, not just missing ones — still present since round 1
carry_forward_notes.detail: A required cohort with a malformed guarantor field (e.g. bad email) still leads the banner with 'A guarantor is required — …' though one was provided. Partial-fill behavior is now explicitly pinned as intended (validate_form_required_cohort_partial_guarantor_states_requirement_test, length 6); the malformed branch reads odd but is the same line. Gating on missing-name or rewording remains optional.

carry_forward_notes.title: Required-cohort rule triplicated (handler / view mirror / JS mirror) with no cross-boundary agreement test — still present since round 1
carry_forward_notes.detail: Each side has a 'MUST STAY IN SYNC' comment and each is pinned independently (truth table, cohort_mirror_agrees, form_guarantor_cohort.test.js), but no single test asserts handler.guarantor_required ⇔ common.guarantor_cohort_is_required ⇔ JS computeGuarantorCohort across the full status matrix. A one-sided drift (e.g. adding a cohort in the handler only) would pass all three suites.
carry_forward_notes.recommended_fix: Add one cross-cutting unit test asserting the full matrix across all three mirrors.
